findings: Critical Defect 1: Orphan lanHeartbeatManager was declared with mDNS/subnet discovery and battery-conservation logic, but was never started (.start()) anywhere in the app.
Critical Defect 2: lanMeshReplicationService was completely detached from LAN discovery, preventing automatic local peer registration.
Critical Defect 3: LanP2PDispatcher had complete dual-transport (BroadcastChannel + WebSocket) capabilities for CITO calls and chair status, but zero UI hooks or listeners.
Critical Defect 4: Split offline subsystem authority between apps/web/src/offline/ and apps/web/src/services/offline/, creating duplicate queues and fragmented exports.
Critical Defect 5: WAN-blindness in offlineStore.ts, useOfflineSync.ts, and workspaceContinuityStrip.tsx where !isOnline treated pure clinic LAN as dead offline.
Critical Defect 6: Error parsing bug in offlineStore.ts where drainResult.errors[0]?.message was undefined instead of .error.
